pullRequest.title: Order cutoff at 10:30
pullRequest.body: The café does its shopping at 10:30, so anything ordered from 10:30 onwards can't be made that day. Orders placed at or after 10:30 now go on the next working day's sheet; Friday afternoon orders roll over to Monday.
pullRequest.author: sam

comments.author: joss
comments.body: 630 is a bit magic. Can we call it CUTOFF_MINUTES, or keep the cutoff as '10:30' and parse it, so the next person doesn't have to do the arithmetic?

comments.author: joss
comments.body: Could this also post in #lunch when the cutoff passes, so people know their order slipped to tomorrow? Feels like a small addition while you're here.

comments.author: joss
